description: Append a shot to a sequence's timeline. Call it once per shot, in cutting order — `start_time` is computed from the clips already there, so appending in order is enough. The continuity pass reads exactly this timeline: a shot missing here is a shot nobody checks. Returns the new clip's index and the sequence's total duration.

duration_seconds.description: Clip duration in seconds. Backend default is 5.0 — pass the clip's REAL length, otherwise the sequence duration and the render drift apart

metadata.description: JSON stored alongside the clip. The continuity pass reads video_id (a generated video's id — it checks the start image), image_url (a frame URL), location_id and scene_num from here; for a 'lower_third', versatz_s (seconds into the clip it sits on) sets when it appears; other keys are stored as-is

seq_id.description: Sequence id (from lab_create_sequence/lab_list_sequences) — positive integer as string

source_id.description: For type 'image': the id of a generated image (from lab_generate). For type 'video': source_id is IGNORED by the continuity pass (a video id used to be misread as an unrelated image, see vault/followups/2026-08-04-continuity-loest-source-id-blind-auf.md). Give a video clip its frame via metadata instead: metadata.video_id = the generated video's id (the pass checks the video's start image), or metadata.image_url = a frame URL. Without either, the shot is counted as 'not checked' (summary.ohne_frame).

start_time.description: Absolute start on the timeline. Omit to append after the last clip (the normal case); set it only to place a clip deliberately

type.description: What this clip is. 'image' references a generated image via source_id; 'title', 'credits' and 'lower_third' carry `text` instead. 'lower_third' is an OVERLAY: appended without start_time it is laid over the clip before it (track V2), takes no time of its own and never runs past that clip's end; metadata.versatz_s delays it inside that clip. As the very first clip it is a card on black. 'video' is where it gets sharp — read the source_id note before using it

name: lab_add_clip
title: Add Clip to Sequence
